sights.n: Old Public Hall of Hakodate Ward (旧函館区公会堂)
sights.address: Motomachi, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan (top of Motoizaka slope)
sights.w: The blue-grey and yellow 1910 colonial-style assembly hall looking over the port from the top of Motoizaka — an Important Cultural Property.

sights.n: Former British Consulate of Hakodate (函館市旧イギリス領事館)
sights.w: The British consulate building of Hakodate's treaty-port era in Motomachi, now a city-run museum of the port's opening.
The observation tower beside the fort — the only way to see Goryōkaku's five-pointed star from above.

sights.address: Goryōkaku Park, Goryōkaku-chō, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Built by the Edo shogunate in the late Edo period inside Goryōkaku to oversee northern defence and foreign affairs; restored on its original site.
The straight, stone-curbed slope that runs from Motomachi straight down to the harbour — Hakodate's most photographed view, lit up in winter.
